topics.title: Enforce shared agent access across devices

entries.title: Enforce shared agent access across devices
entries.rationale: Accepted as cross-device agent access hardening. Preserve authenticated relay membership as the candidate source, signed owner/profile/policy chain, fail-closed mention and owner-only behavior, revocation ordering, and serialized provider policy redeploys.
security_reasons: relay membership and exact author coordinates become the access authority
owner/profile/policy signatures control cross-device agent visibility
runtime/provider deployment must revoke or narrow access without widening unrelated agents
failed directory, owner, or policy evidence must fail closed

tracking.implementation_plan: Implement only after dedicated managed-agent authorization threat review, revocation/deploy ordering tests, dependency/egress screening, Zion branding checks, compatibility checks, and desktop/Tauri gates.

verification: Full-SHA diff, relay-directory trust chain, provider access/reconciliation, runtime lifecycle, changed tests, dependency impact, and compatibility surfaces reviewed; no source implementation made.
